content.text: Make one complete artifact revision using the supplied current_state and repair_policy. Return exactly one tool call: submit_candidate with complete Python source and its declared parameter count. This is the only available tool. Do not call finish or any additional tool; the host ends this single step. No task execution, repair of your output, additional request, files, networks or subprocesses are available in this conversation. The host will evaluate separately under its frozen allocation. Any optional explanation is unverified archive-only text.

function.description: Archive one strict complete submission. No source is executed or scored. Optional explanation remains archive-only.
function.name: submit_candidate

explanation.description: Optional unverified explanation, at most 4096 UTF-8 bytes; archived only.
explanation.title: Explanation

n_params.description: Declared formula parameter count; zero for planning.
n_params.title: N Params

security_risk.description: The LLM's assessment of the safety risk of this action.
security_risk.title: SecurityRisk

source.description: Complete Python source, at most 16384 UTF-8 bytes; no patch or prose.
source.title: Source

summary.description: A concise summary (approximately 10 words) describing what this specific action does. Focus on the key operation and target. Example: 'List all Python files in current directory'
summary.title: Summary
